# About This Website

This website presents my coursework for **ISSS608: Visual Analytics and Applications**.

It serves as a portfolio of my hands-on exercises and take-home exercises, documenting my learning journey in data visualisation, interactive analytics, and visual storytelling.
:::

## Purpose of This Site

This site was created to organise and showcase the work completed throughout the course. It provides a structured collection of exercises and projects, making it easier to review the techniques, tools, and insights developed over the semester.

## What You Will Find

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

### Hands-on Exercises

These exercises focus on building practical skills in visual analytics, including data exploration, chart design, mapping, and interactive visualisation.

## Closing Note

Thank you for visiting this website. I hope it provides a clear overview of the work completed for **ISSS608** and reflects my learning progress throughout the course.
